title: Tendency CallOut Text 4
description:
“On the outside, Talvin Wilks (dramaturge) and I follow the dancers’ attention and I identify the specificities of their action. I find myself drawn to the pull of attention, the sweep of action, the arrested moment, the pressure between people.”
----- Bebe Miller
